four_records.hybrid_record:
On 28 March 2024, U.S. draft S/2024/255 received 13 votes in favour, a Russian veto and a Chinese abstention [VOTE]. The draft proposed extending the 1718 Committee’s Panel of Experts through 30 April 2025, preserving independent, fact-based assessments and requesting midterm and final reports to the Committee [MANDATE, REPORTING]. Neither the extension nor the proposed reporting obligations took effect. The Panel mandate ended on 30 April 2024. The Committee continued and existing sanctions remained in force [SCOPE].

Analytical suggestion: assess options for continued reporting to the Committee.
